title: Hearing loss treated with cochlear implantation
summary: Hearing loss treated with cochlear implantation; considered disabled for 1 year following implantation, after which evaluation is based on word recognition score on HINT (≤60% qualifies).

children.criterion: Within 1 year of cochlear implantation surgery (claimant considered disabled for 1 year)
After 1 year, word recognition score of 60% or less determined by HINT (Hearing in Noise Test)
